label: Название
description: A 10-sentence usage card for название (name; title).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Название' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Интересное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'у книги' frames whose title it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Название' is the accusative direct object of 'забыл', identical to the nominative because the noun is neuter inanimate. The phrase admits forgetting a title.
Strategic focus: Genitive case. 'Названия' is the genitive form governed by the negated 'не помню'. 'Точного' agrees in the genitive neuter, marking the exact title.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Название' is the accusative object of 'придумали', identical to the nominative for this neuter noun. 'Хорошее' agrees in the neuter form.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Названием' is in the instrumental case expressing what the shop was named with. 'Смешным' agrees in the instrumental neuter.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О названии' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express what is debated. 'Команды' is genitive, marking whose title is discussed.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Названия' is the nominative plural subject of the impersonal predicate. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'трудно' evaluates the difficulty.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Названия' is the accusative plural object of 'читаю', identical to the nominative plural for this inanimate neuter noun. 'Всех улиц' is genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Названий' is in the genitive plural after 'много', which governs the genitive of counted items. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with dative. 'Название' is the accusative object of 'дайте', and 'этому проекту' is the dative recipient. 'Новое' agrees in the neuter accusative.
